description: This file defines the Coupon controller class for the Opencart admin extension, handling the display and saving of coupon total settings in the admin interface.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing the coupon total extension in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the coupon total extension settings page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and main view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of coupon total extension settings via AJAX, including permission checks and JSON response.
